snippet.title: Death Kitchen Updated Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Death Kitchen is a fast-paced online co-op horror cooking game. Decide between a chef and a waiter, then coordinate with your friends to serve alien customers who can kill you if you make a mistake. Embrace the chaos and deliver quality with your new intergalactic restaurant chain.
===========================

Don't forget to Subscribe!

Credits (in order of appearance):
Music by https://bsky.app/profile/felixrl.me
Voice of Narrator: Dana
Voice of BigChef95: Jeanette 
Voice of LettucePerson22: Horton
Voice of 88888888: Quentin Noel
Note: The names are for marketing purposes and were not chosen by these voice actors.
